name: Someone the party meets
description: Who they are, what they want, what they hide, and how they carry it. Four lines from one roll.

tables.name: Someone the party meets
tables.description: Roll it when the party talks to somebody you did not prepare.

entries.body: A ferryman with one oar.
A lamplighter finishing early.
A clerk from the customs house, off duty and drinking.
A midwife who knows every family in the district.
A retired soldier running a stall of second-hand boots.
A child selling eels from a bucket.
A priest of a small god, collecting for the roof.
A tax assessor with a ledger under one arm.
A carter whose mule will not move.
A musician between engagements.
A gravedigger on their lunch.
A pickpocket who has already noticed the party.
A scholar looking for a building that is not where the map says.
A fishwife who runs the quay in all but title.
A courier who has lost the letter.
A guard captain's spouse, out of uniform and out of patience.
An apothecary with stained fingers.
A beggar who used to be somebody.
A stonemason repairing a wall that keeps falling down.
A stranger who knows the party's names.

tables.name: Someone the party meets: what they want
tables.description: Right now, from the party or from anyone.

entries.body: Wants their debt forgotten.
Wants to be somewhere else by nightfall.
Wants a witness.
Wants the party to leave, politely.
Wants a sibling found.
Wants to sell something they should not have.
Wants an apology, and will not say for what.
Wants to be hired, for anything.
Wants a story to tell tonight.
Wants the guard to look the other way.
Wants to know if the rumours are true.
Wants a name for a face.
Wants their old job back.
Wants a place to hide a box.
Wants to win an argument they had this morning.
Wants to be forgiven by somebody dead.
Wants a reason not to go home.
Wants the party's opinion, and will act on it.
Wants a coin, and nothing more.
Wants to be remembered.

tables.name: Someone the party meets: what they hide
tables.description: What they will not say unless asked twice.

entries.body: Hides a letter they cannot read.
Hides that they saw it happen.
Hides a second trade, done at night.
Hides that the money is not theirs.
Hides a child.
Hides that they were sent.
Hides a limp, badly.
Hides that they have met one of the party before.
Hides a key on a cord around their neck.
Hides that they are leaving tonight.
Hides nothing at all, which nobody believes.
Hides who they are working for.
Hides a talent they are ashamed of.
Hides that the story they are telling is somebody else's.
Hides a grudge against a person the party likes.
Hides a map, drawn from memory, wrong in one place.
Hides that they are afraid of the water.
Hides a name they used to go by.
Hides that they can hear the party whispering.
Hides that they have already decided to help.

tables.name: Someone the party meets: how they carry it
tables.description: One thing to do with your hands or your voice while you play them.

entries.body: Talks to the ground.
Laughs a beat too late.
Counts on their fingers while listening.
Never says the party's names, only "you lot".
Stands too close.
Answers a question with a question.
Keeps one hand in a pocket the whole time.
Repeats the last word anyone says.
Smells of smoke.
Speaks very quietly, so everyone leans in.
Is eating, and offers some.
Looks at the door every few sentences.
Is kinder than they mean to be.
Corrects people's grammar.
Hums while thinking.
Calls everybody "friend", and means none of it.
Has a dog that does the listening.
Will not sit down.
Blinks slowly, like a cat.
Is delighted to be asked anything at all.
